span.normalized: Gold production at the Séguéla and Lindero Mines is in the form of gold doré bars. The Company has entered into non-exclusive precious metals purchase agreements primarily with Auramet International LLC, a precious metals merchant headquartered in New Jersey, USA and Stonex Commodities DMCC, a precious metals trader headquartered in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. Refining arrangements are provided by Metalor USA Refining Corporation, Metalor Technologies SA and Argor-Heraeus SA.
